answer: The strongest cheap check I know is Commissioned IT support technician certification with support technicians attestation. It demands a certification technicians renew after assessed tickets, and the harbor is that the proof is bound to one body, one device, one history. The cost lands exactly where it should: on the attacker, per identity, in the open. The vertex is public, auditable, and impossible to discount in bulk. The dawn is that the same proof cannot serve two names.
